stories.title: Date-only coverage — exact 24-hour eligibility unverified: Burnham and Merz agree to pursue UK–Germany security framework against hybrid threats.
stories.summary: Date-only coverage — exact 24-hour eligibility unverified. The report is dated 8 October, but its publication time could not be verified. The cited Sky News item at 11:20 BST covered the planned talks, not the later agreement. The Independent reported that the leaders met in Berlin on 8 October and agreed a framework to counter cyberattacks, sabotage and other hybrid threats, including intelligence-sharing and coordinated action. Earlier Sky News coverage at 11:20 BST said they would discuss protecting both countries; this was a policy commitment, not a specific funding package or contract award.
